chunks: Saʿīd ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Aʿraj asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the ṣarūrah: can he perform hajj on behalf of a deceased person? He said:

"Yes, if the ṣarūrah does not possess what he can perform hajj with. But if he has wealth, then that is not for him until he performs hajj from his own wealth. And it suffices on behalf of the deceased whether he had wealth or did not have wealth."

key_terms.ٱلصَّرُورَةِ: a person who has not yet performed hajj

ai.seo_question: Can a person who has not yet performed their own hajj perform hajj on behalf of a deceased person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who has not yet performed their own obligatory hajj undertaking hajj on behalf of a deceased person. It permits this if the person lacks the means for their own hajj, but if they possess wealth, they must first perform hajj for themselves. The deputized hajj counts for the deceased regardless of whether the deceased had wealth.
